decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9463. Series context: trend strength 0.6757 and seasonal strength 0.2521; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.212); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.664.
